decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana in order to cast powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also includes a variety of control elements such as Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Karn, the Great Creator and The One Ring provide versatile options to handle different situations and lock down the opponent's resources.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip a massive creature with indestructible, hexproof, and lifelink. The key strategy is to use Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to tutor for the necessary pieces, while also using Esper Sentinel and Emeria's Call for card advantage and token generation. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful creature that is difficult to deal with, while also having backup plans in case the combo pieces are removed.

The main concept of this Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to utilize the powerful Death's Shadow creature alongside aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Orcish Bowmasters to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes efficient disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional threats and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board while lowering its own life total to pump up Death's Shadow and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful threats such as Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Expedition Map and Chromatic Sphere to help dig for key pieces and fuel the mana engine. Control elements like Oblivion Stone and Karn, the Great Creator help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while the land search cards like Sylvan Scrying and Urza's Saga ensure consistency in finding the necessary lands. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overpower opponents with its big threats.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on fast and efficient creature threats combined with disruption spells to control the game. Using a mix of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Tarmogoyf, and Orcish Bowmasters along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt, Terminate, and Fatal Push, the deck seeks to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan. Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recurring land drops, while the Urza's Saga land helps to find key artifacts like Mishra's Bauble or Shadowspear. The deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent to secure victories.

The main focus of this deck is to use cards like Architects of Will, Grief, and Violent Outburst to manipulate the graveyard and cycle through the deck while maintaining control with cards like Force of Negation. By filling up the graveyard with creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Curator of Mysteries, the player can then cast Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck's strategy revolves around setting up this combo as quickly and effectively as possible to secure a victory.

The key concept of this deck is utilizing control elements and powerful creatures to assert dominance over the game. The centerpiece of the deck is The One Ring, which grants immense power and control. The deck focuses on disruption and removal with cards like Subtlety, Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Force of Negation. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Snapcaster Mage, Murktide Regent, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to threaten the opponent's board and maintain control. The deck also includes important lands like Minamo, School at Water's Edge and Watery Grave for additional control options.

The deck aims to control the game with powerful colorless spells and use the UrzaTron lands to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to deal with threats while also having access to big Eldrazi creatures for finishing the game. The deck includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, which can provide additional value and consistency. Overall, the strategy revolves around establishing a strong mana base and using versatile threats and answers to control the game until victory.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful threats, primarily Primeval Titan. It utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer, Azusa, and Amulet of Vigor to accelerate the mana base and enable explosive plays. The combination of Urza's Saga and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove provides additional utility and fixing. The main win condition is to assemble the Amulet Titan combo, where Primeval Titan tutors for lands like Boros Garrison and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion to give haste and multiple combat phases for a lethal attack. The deck also includes utility lands like Valakut and Bojuka Bog to disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck revolves around utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to create a looping combo with artifacts like Grinding Station and Mox Amber to generate infinite mana and draw the deck to win with Thassa's Oracle or deal damage with Unholy Heat. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo. Urza's Saga helps tutor for important artifacts while Mishra's Bauble and The One Ring help draw through the deck efficiently. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional card advantage and mana ramp.

The deck focuses on quickly equipping creatures with powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to create a lethal threat on the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic, the deck can search for and equip these powerful artifacts efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Emeria's Call and Urza's Saga provides additional value and flexibility in the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful equipment.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of powerful Merfolk creatures with abilities that can disrupt the opponent's strategy. Cards like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident boost the team's power and toughness, while Merfolk Trickster and Mistcaller provide control elements. Svyelun of Sea and Sky helps draw additional cards, and Tide Shaper can manipulate lands to gain an advantage. Aether Vial allows for quick creature deployment, while Dismember and Force of Negation provide removal and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive aggro strategy.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly by disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also efficiently removing threats with Fatal Push and Murderous Cut. The deck also aims to control the board with creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while utilizing cards like Malakir Rebirth to bring back key creatures. The inclusion of The One Ring provides additional reach and evasion, making it challenging for the opponent to stabilize and come back once the aggro plan is in motion.

This deck focuses on milling opponents' decks as quickly and efficiently as possible using cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to put cards into the opponent's graveyard. This strategy is further supported by cards like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity. The deck also includes disruption cards like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to control the board and prevent the opponent from interfering with the mill plan. In addition, cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter provide a powerful mass mill effect to speed up the process. The goal is to deplete the opponent's library and win by forcing them to draw from an empty deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to control the game and generate advantage through card draw and mana ramp. Urza, Lord High Artificer serves as the centerpiece of the strategy, allowing for explosive plays and a strong board presence. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by quickly assembling a board of artifact creatures and using counterspells to disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and various artifact synergies provide additional ways to generate value and overwhelm the opponent.

The deck revolves around assembling the Tron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. With powerful threats like Ulamog and Karn, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Oblivion Stone and Karn, the Great Creator provides additional removal and disruption options. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Chromatic Star and The One Ring for card selection and mana fixing, creating a versatile and powerful control strategy.
